findings.issue: Target proves only formula => (P on segment AB and n*AP=m*PB). The reusable fact named 'internal_division_formula' is the converse: P on AB with m:n ratio => p=(na+mb)/(m+n); a proof citing this card cannot derive the position vector. The hard_negative itself assumes the ratio=>formula direction.

patch.statement: 実内積空間の点$\mathrm{A},\mathrm{B},\mathrm{P}$の位置ベクトルを$\vec a,\vec b,\vec p$とし、$m,n>0$とする。$\mathrm{P}$が線分$\mathrm{AB}$上にあり$n\,\mathrm{AP}=m\,\mathrm{PB}$を満たす（すなわち$\mathrm{P}$が線分$\mathrm{AB}$を$m:n$に内分する）ことと、$\vec p=\dfrac{n\vec a+m\vec b}{m+n}$であることは同値である。
patch.statement_en: Let a, b, p be vectors in a real inner product space and m, n > 0. Then p lies on the segment from a to b with n|p-a| = m|b-p| if and only if p = (na+mb)/(m+n).
patch.conclusion: $\mathrm{P}$が線分$\mathrm{AB}$上にあり$n|\vec p-\vec a|=m|\vec b-\vec p|$であることと、$\vec p=\dfrac{n\vec a+m\vec b}{m+n}$であることは同値である。
patch.openmath: (forall (V a b p m n) (-> (and (inner_product_space_over R V) (in a V) (in b V) (in p V) (in m R) (in n R) (> m 0) (> n 0)) (<-> (and (in_segment p a b) (= (* n (norm (- p a))) (* m (norm (- b p))))) (= p (+ (smul (/ n (+ m n)) a) (smul (/ m (+ m n)) b))))))
patch.target: ∀ (V : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (a b P : V) (m n : ℝ), 0 < m → 0 < n → ((P ∈ segment ℝ a b ∧ n * ‖P - a‖ = m * ‖b - P‖) ↔ P = (n / (m + n)) • a + (m / (m + n)) • b)
patch.proof:
by
  intro V _ _ a b P m n hm hn
  have hmn : m + n ≠ 0 := by positivity
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨x, y, hx, hy, hxy, hP⟩, h⟩
    have hy' : y = 1 - x := by linarith
    subst hP
    subst hy'
    have h1 : x • a + (1 - x) • b - a = (1 - x) • (b - a) := by module
    have h2 : b - (x • a + (1 - x) • b) = x • (b - a) := by module
    rw [h1, h2, norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hx, Real.norm_of_nonneg hy] at h
    by_cases hab : ‖b - a‖ = 0
    · have hba : b = a := by
        have := norm_eq_zero.mp hab
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp this
      subst hba
      match_scalars <;> field_simp <;> ring
    · have hxy : n * (1 - x) = m * x := by
        have : n * (1 - x) * ‖b - a‖ = m * x * ‖b - a‖ := by linarith
        exact mul_right_cancel₀ hab this
      have hx' : x = n / (m + n) := by
        field_simp
        linarith
      subst hx'
      match_scalars <;> field_simp <;> ring
  · intro h
    subst h
    have hn' : 0 ≤ n / (m + n) := by positivity
    have hm' : 0 ≤ m / (m + n) := by positivity
    have hsum : n / (m + n) + m / (m + n) = 1 := by field_simp; ring
    refine ⟨⟨n / (m + n), m / (m + n), hn', hm', hsum, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    have h1 : (n / (m + n)) • a + (m / (m + n)) • b - a = (m / (m + n)) • (b - a) := by
      match_scalars <;> field_simp <;> ring
    have h2 : b - ((n / (m + n)) • a + (m / (m + n)) • b) = (n / (m + n)) • (b - a) := by
      match_scalars <;> field_simp <;> ring
    rw [h1, h2, norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hn', Real.norm_of_nonneg hm']
    field_simp
patch.answer:
$\vec a,\vec b,\vec p$を実内積空間のベクトル、$m,n>0$とする。

（右から左）$\vec p=\dfrac{n\vec a+m\vec b}{m+n}$とする。係数$\dfrac{n}{m+n},\dfrac{m}{m+n}$は正で和が$1$なので、$\vec p$は線分$\mathrm{AB}$上にある。また$\vec p-\vec a=\dfrac{m}{m+n}(\vec b-\vec a)$、$\vec b-\vec p=\dfrac{n}{m+n}(\vec b-\vec a)$なので、$n|\vec p-\vec a|=\dfrac{mn}{m+n}|\vec b-\vec a|=m|\vec b-\vec p|$である。

（左から右）$\vec p$が線分$\mathrm{AB}$上にあるので、$0\le\lambda\le1$の$\lambda$で$\vec p=\vec a+\lambda(\vec b-\vec a)$と書ける。このとき$|\vec p-\vec a|=\lambda|\vec b-\vec a|$、$|\vec b-\vec p|=(1-\lambda)|\vec b-\vec a|$なので、条件$n|\vec p-\vec a|=m|\vec b-\vec p|$は$\{n\lambda-m(1-\lambda)\}|\vec b-\vec a|=0$となる。$\vec a=\vec b$なら$\vec p=\vec a$であり、$\dfrac{n\vec a+m\vec b}{m+n}=\vec a$でもある。$\vec a\ne\vec b$なら$n\lambda=m(1-\lambda)$より$\lambda=\dfrac{m}{m+n}$であり、$\vec p=\dfrac{n}{m+n}\vec a+\dfrac{m}{m+n}\vec b$を得る。

findings.issue: Same defect as internal_division_formula: only formula => ratio relation is proved. The useful direction (n(p-a)=m(p-b) => p=(-na+mb)/(m-n)) is absent although the card is named a formula. The norm equation is a trivial corollary and can be dropped.

patch.statement: 実内積空間の点$\mathrm{A},\mathrm{B},\mathrm{P}$の位置ベクトルを$\vec a,\vec b,\vec p$とし、$m,n>0$、$m\neq n$とする。$n(\vec p-\vec a)=m(\vec p-\vec b)$（すなわち$\mathrm{P}$が線分$\mathrm{AB}$を$m:n$に外分する）ことと、$\vec p=\dfrac{-n\vec a+m\vec b}{m-n}$であることは同値である。
patch.statement_en: Let a, b, p be vectors in a real inner product space, m, n > 0, m ≠ n. Then n(p-a) = m(p-b) if and only if p = (-na+mb)/(m-n).
patch.conclusion: $n(\vec p-\vec a)=m(\vec p-\vec b)$と$\vec p=\dfrac{-n\vec a+m\vec b}{m-n}$は同値である。
patch.openmath: (forall (V a b p m n) (-> (and (inner_product_space_over R V) (in a V) (in b V) (in p V) (in m R) (in n R) (> m 0) (> n 0) (!= m n)) (<-> (= p (+ (smul (/ (neg n) (- m n)) a) (smul (/ m (- m n)) b))) (= (smul n (- p a)) (smul m (- p b))))))
patch.target: ∀ (V : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (a b P : V) (m n : ℝ), 0 < m → 0 < n → m ≠ n → (P = (-n / (m - n)) • a + (m / (m - n)) • b ↔ n • (P - a) = m • (P - b))
patch.proof:
by
  intro V _ _ a b P m n hm hn hne
  have hd : m - n ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hne
  constructor
  · intro h
    subst h
    match_scalars <;> field_simp <;> ring
  · intro h
    have h3 : n • (P - a) - m • (P - b) = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
    have h' : (m - n) • P = (-n) • a + m • b := by
      calc (m - n) • P = (-n) • a + m • b - (n • (P - a) - m • (P - b)) := by module
        _ = (-n) • a + m • b := by rw [h3, sub_zero]
    have : P = (m - n)⁻¹ • ((m - n) • P) := by rw [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hd, one_smul]
    rw [this, h']
    match_scalars <;> field_simp

findings.issue: OpenMath writes (inner_product (- b a) (- c a)) for complex numbers with no carrier. The Lean statement uses the REAL inner product Re(conj(b-a)(c-a)); a reader of the OpenMath would take the Hermitian complex product conj(b-a)(c-a), for which '=0' is a different (here false) statement. Spell out the real inner product.

patch.statement_en: For complex numbers a ≠ b and c, the real inner product Re(conj(b-a)(c-a)) of the plane vectors b-a and c-a vanishes if and only if Re((c-a)/(b-a)) = 0.
patch.openmath: (forall (a b c) (-> (and (in a C) (in b C) (in c C) (!= a b)) (<-> (= (real_part (* (complex_conj (- b a)) (- c a))) 0) (= (real_part (/ (- c a) (- b a))) 0))))

patch.statement: 実内積空間の$\vec 0$でないベクトル$\vec a,\vec b$のなす角を$\theta$とすると、三角形の面積の2つの公式の値は一致する。すなわち（面積そのものは扱わず、2式の等式として）$\dfrac12|\vec a||\vec b|\sin\theta=\dfrac12\sqrt{|\vec a|^2|\vec b|^2-(\vec a\cdot\vec b)^2}$が成り立つ。

patch.statement: $r\ge0$、$a,b,p,q$を実数とする。円板$(x-p)^2+(y-q)^2\le r^2$における$ax+by$の最大値は$ap+bq+r\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$である（$p=q=0$なら$r\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$）。
patch.statement_en: For r≥0 and real a,b,p,q, the maximum of ax+by over the disc (x-p)^2+(y-q)^2≤r^2 equals ap+bq+r√(a^2+b^2).

hard_negative.statement: 中心が$(p,q)$の円板でも最大値は$r\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$である。
hard_negative.reason: 中心での値$ap+bq$が加わる。$(x-1)^2+y^2\le1$での$x$の最大値は$2$であるが、この式は$1$を与える。

patch.target: ∀ (a b p q r : ℝ), 0 ≤ r → IsGreatest {s : ℝ | ∃ x y : ℝ, (x - p) ^ 2 + (y - q) ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 2 ∧ s = a * x + b * y} (a * p + b * q + r * Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2))
patch.proof:
by
  intro a b p q r hr
  have hS : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hSS : Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  constructor
  · by_cases h0 : Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) = 0
    · have ha : a = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg a, sq_nonneg b]
      have hb : b = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg a, sq_nonneg b]
      refine ⟨p, q, by simp; positivity, ?_⟩
      rw [h0, ha, hb]; ring
    · have hpos : 0 < Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := lt_of_le_of_ne hS (Ne.symm h0)
      refine ⟨p + r * a / Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2), q + r * b / Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2), ?_, ?_⟩
      · have : (r * a / Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)) ^ 2 + (r * b / Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := by
          field_simp
          rw [hSS]
        nlinarith [this]
      · field_simp
        nlinarith [hSS]
  · rintro s ⟨x, y, hxy, rfl⟩
    have h1 : (a * (x - p) + b * (y - q)) ^ 2 ≤ (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) * r ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a * (y - q) - b * (x - p)), mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxy (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)]
    have h2 : a * (x - p) + b * (y - q) ≤ Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) * r := by
      apply abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' _ (by positivity) |>.2
      nlinarith [hSS]
    nlinarith [h2]
patch.answer:
$a,b,p,q,r$を実数とし、$r\ge0$とする。$S=\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$とおく。

上からの評価。円板内の点$(x,y)$について$u=x-p$、$v=y-q$とおくと$u^2+v^2\le r^2$である。$(a^2+b^2)(u^2+v^2)-(au+bv)^2=(av-bu)^2\ge0$より$(au+bv)^2\le S^2r^2$であり、$rS\ge0$なので$au+bv\le rS$である。よって$ax+by=ap+bq+(au+bv)\le ap+bq+rS$である。

等号をとる点。$S=0$なら$a=b=0$であり、中心$(p,q)$で$ax+by=0=ap+bq+rS$である。$S>0$なら点$\left(p+\frac{ra}{S},q+\frac{rb}{S}\right)$は$u^2+v^2=r^2$を満たし、そこでの値は$ap+bq+\frac{r(a^2+b^2)}{S}=ap+bq+rS$である。

findings.issue: Described as 'the two area formulas agree' but no area is formalised; target is the 2-D Lagrange identity under sqrt. State it as an identity (real area: geometry_plane.triangle_area_sine).

patch.statement_en: For real a1,a2,b1,b2, the two triangle-area expressions agree: (1/2)√((a1²+a2²)(b1²+b2²)-(a1b1+a2b2)²) = (1/2)|a1b2-a2b1| (identity only; no area is defined).

hard_negative.reason: 焦点と頂点の距離は$\frac{1}{4|a|}$である。$y=x^2$の頂点$(0,0)$はグラフ上にあり、点$\left(0,\frac14\right)$と直線$y=-\frac14$からの距離はともに$\frac14$である。一方、$(0,1)$までの距離は$1$であり、直線$y=-\frac14$までの距離$\frac14$と異なる。

findings.issue: Target and OpenMath are six ring-identities on coordinates: no median, midpoint or centroid concept appears (core vocabulary has midpoint_of, centroid_of, plane_point), so retrieval by 'centroid' cannot match and any identical-looking identity would encode identically.

systemic: Vector cards (school_vectors_complex 0-23) never bind vectors/scalars to their carrier: OpenMath has (inner_product_space_over R V) but no (in a V)/(in p R), and the zero vector is the numeral 0 ((!= b 0), (= ... 0)). Fix: add (in a V) conjuncts, write nonzero as (!= (norm b) 0) or (!= b (smul 0 b)).

Representation is sound: coordinate cards use plain real coordinates (R x R only as a tuple in two exists-unique statements, never with norm/dist); the only Euclidean-distance card uses EuclideanSpace R (Fin 2); complex cards use inner R on C (Re(conj w z)) and Complex.arg in (-pi,pi], matching principal_arg. No sup-norm hazard found.

Coordinate geometry cards spell geometric notions as expanded polynomials although core.yaml has on_line/on_circle/midpoint_of/centroid_of/dist_of; only card 0 uses dist_of. Retrieval by concept is lost; acceptable only because the Lean targets are also expanded.

Same pattern is repeated in coordinate, vector and complex form (internal division, diameter circle, Apollonius, collinearity, perpendicular, point-line/plane distance); each statement must say its form, otherwise reviewers reuse the wrong one.

'Formula' cards sometimes prove only formula => property (vector internal/external division) while the useful direction is ratio => formula; 'area' cards (ana 8, vec 20) are algebraic identities with no area.

Hard negatives and answers are otherwise accurate (all 107 counterexamples checked; answers complete). Hypotheses nonzero/b!=0 are sometimes redundant in Lean (vec 5, 17, 18, 20; ana 5 distinctness) - harmless.
